heading: A dedicated Preferences window
summary: Manage PromeFTP settings in a separate macOS window, with four interface languages.
changes: Use the General, Terminal, Authentication, Shortcuts, and About tabs without covering your workspace.
In General → Language, choose English, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, or follow macOS. Save to apply the language while your sessions stay open.
Review saved answers and global rules under Authentication. Find keyboard commands under Shortcuts.
Existing font and scrollback choices carry forward and apply to open terminals when you save.
notice: Close active SSH, SFTP, and local shell sessions before installing. Requires macOS 13 or later on Apple Silicon.
